raw_segments.text: A professional gentleman, thus familiarly pointed out, had been all the time standing
near them, with nothing specific visible, to denote his gentlemanly rank on board.
His face was an exceedingly round, but sober one.
He was dressed in a faded blue woolen frock or shirt, and patched trozers, and had thus
far been dividing his attention between a marling spike he held in one hand, and a pill
box held in the other, occasionally casting a critical glance at the ivory limbs of the
But at his superior's introduction of him to Ahab, he politely bowed, and straightway
went on to do his captain's bidding.
